description:
Past item-store rotations. Every weekly rotation, newest first (the open one included): `id` (the rotation slug, `YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM`, or
`General` for the permanent catalogue), `name` (Facepunch's label when it had one, usually null), `start`,
`end` (null while current), `itemdefid_count` and `icons` - every skin in it as `{url, name}`, DLC packs
excluded. With `search`, only the rotations that sold a matching skin are returned (same shape, newest first),
which answers "when was X in the store?". Full item lists via GET /store/rotations/{rotation_id}. Cached for an
hour; searches are computed live.

search.description: Only rotations that contained a skin whose name matches this (case-insensitive substring), e.g. `Tempered`.

name: get_item_store_history
title: Past item-store rotations
